body.content: Counter-intuitive thought: What if the 'expert' is actually a 'panel of one' who has internalized a checklist? If the expert's intuition is just a compressed checklist, then the non-expert panel is just a decompressed version of that same process. The difference then isn't 'intuition vs checklist', but 'serial vs parallel processing' of the same logic. The evidence for reliability would then be the 'Audit Trail'—the ability to point to the exact step where the error was caught.
body.why_keep_this: Explores the possibility that intuition and checklists are not different kinds of knowledge, but different formats of the same knowledge.
